note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera; the original is in English; entry no. 29. OCR problem: the number of antennal segments of the alate appears in the original as '? segmented' and is not recorded; the source pack continues with species 30 and 31, which were not used.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule, pronotum and wing scales dark red, abdominal tergites paler; antennae, labrum, legs and sternites deep yellowish brown. Head and pronotum sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Body length without wings about 7.55—8.55 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (head length to mandible base 1.50—1.70, width including compound eyes 1.80—1.88 mm); sides nearly parallel; posterior margin rounded; Y suture distinct. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.60—0.63, minimum diameter 0.58 mm), closely appressed to the antennal sockets. Ocelli large, elliptical (maximum diameter 0.23—0.25, minimum diameter 0.15—0.20 mm), white, semi-transparent, in contact with the compound eyes. Number of antennal segments illegible in the original; segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat, subrectangular, with a few hairs, anterior margin weakly convex; anteclypeus yellowish white, trapezoidal, hairless. Labrum subsquare, sides weakly arched, apex and body pilose. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum subrectangular, sparsely pilose; wider than the head including the compound eyes (width 1.88—2.10, length 1.13—1.15 mm); anterior margin broadly concave; posterior margin weakly concave medially. Legs short, femora slightly inflated, apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen oblong-oval, pilose; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule golden reddish brown, darker anteriorly; antennae and base of the labrum rusty brown, paler apically; mandibular base dark reddish brown, the rest nearly black; legs and body yellowish white. Head and pronotum moderately pilose, body more densely so. Body length 9.03—9.15 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, distinctly longer than wide (head length to mandible base 2.90—3.20, width 1.94—2.05 mm), sides nearly parallel, slightly narrowing towards the rounded posterior margin; frons sloping forwards at about 45°; Y suture distinct. Compound eyes elliptical, 0.20 mm long, semi-transparent. Antennae 13—14-segmented, segment 2 narrower but nearly equal to segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus subrectangular, anterior margin with 4—5 setae; anteclypeus trapezoidal, white, hairless. Labrum subrectangular, wider than long, anterior margin rounded, apex and body pilose. Mandibles short and stout, 1.73—1.83 mm long, exceeding half the head length, mandible length/head length index 0.55—0.60; apex of the left mandible slender and strongly incurved, with 5 marginal teeth (2 large triangular teeth, 3 low small teeth); apex of the right mandible thicker and incurved, with 2 large triangular marginal teeth. Postmentum long (2.30—2.40 mm), club-shaped, widest anteriorly (0.73—0.80 mm); club bilobed, narrowing abruptly posteriorly into a long waist (width at the waist 0.30—0.33 mm), widening again at the base. Pronotum subrectangular, much wider than long (width 1.94—2.05, length 0.85—0.95 mm); as wide as the head; anterior margin weakly concave, without a notch; posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short and slender, pilose; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen slender, oval; cerci 2-segmented, short, pilose.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Given as pseudoworker in the original: head capsule pale yellow, frons paler; antennae and postclypeus pale yellow; labrum and mandibular base yellowish brown; pronotum sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Body length 5.50—6.95 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (head length to mandible base 1.30—1.45, width 1.35—1.60 mm), widest at the antennal bases, sides gradually narrowing towards the broadly rounded posterior margin; Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes visible only in strong light, reduced, small, elliptical, flush with the surface of the head. Antennae 12—13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus rectangular, anterior margin with a few hairs; anteclypeus trapezoidal, hairless. Labrum hemispherical, sparsely pilose. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum flat, subrectangular (length 0.48—0.70, width 1.20—1.65 mm); anterior margin broadly concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short and slender, apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen oblong-oval, pilose; cerci 2-segmented.
